resources.string: Root and LSPosed are optional enhancement layers. Standard Android and accessibility paths remain available when enhancements are disabled.
When disabled, individual selections are retained, but runtime uses only standard Android and accessibility implementations.
Allows integrated and individually enabled enhanced providers to participate in backend selection.
Opening this page never requests Root automatically. su is invoked only when a Root feature is used or authorization is explicitly checked.
Allow integrated Root enhancements to participate in backend selection.
Effective only when enhanced mode and Root features are both enabled. Otherwise screenshots continue using standard backends.
Checking Root authorization. The Root manager may show an authorization dialog.
Root is unavailable or not authorized.
Root screenshots require enhanced mode, Root features, and Root screenshot enhancement to be enabled. Root screenshots are not invoked if any requirement is missing.
Root can stop Google App and same-package processes such as search, interactor, and googleapp. Normal stop does not disable the app. Freeze disables Google App until it is restored manually.
Enable enhanced mode and Root features first.
Stopping Google App and remaining same-package processes with Root.
Google Search, Assistant, and Google screen recognition will be unavailable until Restore and launch is selected here.

Stop Google performs Root force-stop, clears remaining com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox processes, then force-stops again without disabling the app. Use Freeze Google to prevent long-term system relaunch. Restore and launch re-enables Google and launches it once to clear the force-stop stopped state.
API 102 Remote Preferences synchronizes app switches to system_server and SystemUI. Secure-window screenshots change system capture behavior only during YFloat’s short capture lease.
Allows integrated LSPosed features to use cross-process configuration. Each feature still has its own switch.

YFloat’s screen-recognition action uses Google Circle to Search when enabled. Only sessions initiated by YFloat with its session marker are handled. Native Google activation from Home or the gesture bar is unchanged. Google App must be in the LSPosed scope and load the current module version.
Creates a short authorization only while YFloat captures. Requires enhanced mode, LSPosed Provider, and an actually loaded system_server module. FLAG_SECURE is never removed permanently.
Reading LSPosed framework and Hook generation state.
Reloading Google and SystemUI Hooks requires enhanced mode and Root features.
Reloading changed Google and SystemUI Hooks.
A Hook reload task is already running.

Hook changes and ordinary app-code changes are evaluated separately. UI, OCR, dialogs, settings, and other ordinary updates never restart targets. Google Hook changes restart only Google processes. SystemUI Hook changes restart only SystemUI. Only system_server Hook changes require a device reboot. Recommended scope: system, com.android.systemui, and com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox.
Fall back to standard methods when an enhanced backend fails so Root or Hook failures do not affect basic functionality.
Use standard methods when enhancement fails
For example, retry an accessibility screenshot after a Root screenshot fails, or use a standard screenshot if an LSPosed lease cannot be established.
